items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: A Mapbox GL map container with light/dark theming, Standard style + light preset support, and a useMap() context for composing children.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A marker placed at given coordinates. Renders a default pin or custom content, and exposes itself for an attached Popup.

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup
items.description: A popup with custom React content. Auto-attaches to a parent Marker, or stands alone at given coordinates.

items.name: controls
items.title: Controls
items.description: Tailwind-styled zoom and geolocate buttons overlaid on the map.

items.name: layer
items.title: Layer
items.description: A declarative GeoJSON source + layer as a child of Map. Survives style swaps, updates data via setData, and passes the Mapbox paint/layout spec straight through.

items.name: choropleth
items.title: Choropleth
items.description: Regions coloured by a data value, with outlines and feature-state hover highlighting. Its ramp object is shared with Legend so swatches cannot drift from the paint.

items.name: legend
items.title: Legend
items.description: A map legend rendered from the same ramp object that drives the Choropleth paint expression, so swatches cannot drift from the colours on the map.

items.name: store-locator
items.title: Store Locator
items.description: A full-page store locator: a searchable location list, fly-to navigation, and popups on a Mapbox map.
